name: Raspberry Pi 5 · Monitor
description: A Pi 5 on a flat 1080p monitor: sharp pictures with a light CRT look the Pi's GPU keeps up with
notes: CRT shader on: koko-aio's Monitor Balanced look, scanlines and mask, glow, halo and vignette
No bezel, ambilight, curvature, bloom or glare: the costliest parts on the Pi 5, and a flat monitor needs no frame
Batocera's decorations off, no smoothing, no integer scaling: the shader fills the screen
Rewind off: it costs the Pi 5 frames in the heavier systems
Nintendo DS without the CRT shader: its two screens are not a CRT's
